candidates.title: DynaNDE: Dynamic Near-Data Expert Scheduling for Batched MoE Inference
candidates.reason: Direct MoE data-movement work: analytical NPU-NDP scheduling with expert concurrency and reuse-aware placement; reports 2.6x prefill and 2.2x decode speedup over prior NPU-NDP MoE serving.

candidates.title: Faster Than Flash: Exploiting Attention Sparsity for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
candidates.reason: Hardware-algorithm co-design for long-context decoding: fused selector/compute kernel, low-bit content-aware scan and adaptive sparsity; reports up to 11.6x kernel speedup and 2.37x end-to-end throughput.

candidates.title: FlashAccel: Leveraging High-Bandwidth Flash for High-Throughput LLM Inference
candidates.reason: High-bandwidth-flash/HBM co-design for model weights and KV cache, with specialized layouts and heterogeneous storage management; highly relevant to SSD/HBF hierarchical-memory lineage.

candidates.title: FLINT: Efficiently Leveraging High Bandwidth Flash for Capacity-Scalable LLM Inference Acceleration
candidates.reason: HBF capacity-tier architecture with burst buffering, refresh off critical path and read-only flash translation optimized for inference weights; strong adjacent-memory-system candidate.
